speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your newborn consultation. I see you have a generalized rash; to determine the cause, tell me, is the baby currently breastfeeding or formula-fed?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Infection (Neonatal Conjunctivitis/Skin Infection).

The infant presents with a generalized rash one day after birth, and the mother has a history of treated gonorrhea. Given the incubation period and the maternal history, I am concerned about disseminated gonococcal infection despite prior treatment. I will proceed with testing to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture, REQUEST TEST: Gonococcal_Culture_from_skin_lesions.
